historical_resume_prompt_evidence.excerpt: Remaining shared budget: $13.04. Do not restart from scratch. Read .agent_sessions/codex/budget_status.json before more work. This continuation authorizes useful finishing work even when wrap_up is true. Warnings change priorities, not permission to work. Identify a remaining uncertainty, run a focused check using your tools, and correct any issue the evidence reveals. Validation that leaves the policy unchanged is useful work too. If still uncertain, continue with the next useful check while budget remains; do not merely repeat that the policy is saved or that the budget is low. Before stopping, create .agent_sessions/codex/solution_confident only if extremely confident; otherwise leave it absent.
